text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: City, happy b-day. ☆ So, you check<n>your phone yet?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you mean about today's takoyaki<n>party?
Thanks for planning it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gotta pull out all the stops for my<n>gal's birthday! I
even called in a<n>certified pro—this party 'bout to be
fire!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A pro? Oh, is that why—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heya, pleased to be of service!<n>Takoyaki pro,
Tamamo Cross here!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I got ya covered. To make sure<n>nothing affects your
work, I'll make<n>healthy takoyaki with tons of
veggies!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So, whaddya wanna fill 'em with?<n>There's more
than just octopus!<n>Something good for ya skin?
Tomato<n>maybe?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's her birthday, so we can't be<n>holding back!
She's got a sweet<n>tooth, so how about chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, you're an adventurous<n>one too, aren't
ya? But hey, it's<n>worth a try—done!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is it just me, or are you two more<n>excited about this
than me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Heh... Not that that's a bad thing.
